summary: Pierce County, WA: a lookout built in 1934 as O'Farrell or South Prairie, abandoned by the state in 1959 and burned in 1960. Footings remain, reached through a gate.

facts.design: Pole L-4 tower; sources give 20 feet (two) or 15 feet (one)
facts.status_note: Tower abandoned in 1959 and burned; the only remains described are foundation footings, found in 2015

access.note: The route crosses a gate on a Wilkeson tree-farm road; park below the gate. No source describes the visiting rules.

visit.trail_note: Drive to Wilkeson, then FS 7710 for 4.3 miles to a Y, then 0.2 miles to a gate; park below it. Hike listed at 4.5 miles with 1,300 ft of climbing from the gate, plus off-trail searching for footings

events.note: Activated August 31, 1942; deactivated October 16, 1943 (Seattle Filter Center)

DNR letter dated July 3, 1959 abandons the lookout because of poor condition
Lookout duties moved to Carbon Ridge Lookout; WillhiteWeb says 1961
A 1960 entry says the Forest Service burned the tower; a November 1959 photo caption says just before being burned

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two sources give 20 feet (Former Fire Lookout Sites Register, WillhiteWeb) and one gives 15 feet (firelookout.com). The story reports the disagreement and does not choose one.
firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page date the handover to Carbon Ridge to 1960; WillhiteWeb says 1961. The story gives both.
firelookout.com lists Jane Stanton as O'Farrell personnel for 1958; WillhiteWeb lists her 1958 season and Helen Jones's 1959 season under the Carbon Ridge heading. The story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: coordinates, 986.3 m elevation and US 1291 / WA 191 match the cached pages. No corrections. Agency: firelookout.com says Mount Baker-Snoqualmie National Forest/DNR; the story keeps DNR as the brief and the register have it. The burning date rests on one 1960 entry, and the 1959 photo caption places the burning after November 1959. The 1958-59 staffing names need a human check because the WillhiteWeb layout puts them under Carbon Ridge.
